name: restaurant-qr-ordering-system
description: Full-stack automated restaurant QR code ordering system

scripts.build: cp qr-menu-frontend/index.html qr-menu-frontend/public/200.html && npm --prefix qr-menu-frontend install && npm --prefix qr-menu-frontend run build && rm -rf dist && cp -r qr-menu-frontend/dist ./dist && rm -f ./dist/_redirects
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix qr-menu-backend run dev" "npm --prefix qr-menu-frontend run dev"
